Roborock Qrevo Curv replacement parts.

For the U.S. Roborock Qrevo Curv robot, model V10VIV, with EWFD26LRR Empty Wash Fill Dock. Match your robot and dock labels before choosing parts.

Check the variant: Qrevo Curv uses a DuoDivide main-brush assembly, a FlexiArm Arc side brush and two round spinning mop cloths. Do not assume CurvX or Qrevo Curv 2 Flow accessories fit: the Curv mop cloth listing explicitly excludes CurvX, and Curv 2 Flow uses a different roller-mop system.

Fit: The Roborock-branded Amazon listing explicitly names Qrevo Curv, and Roborock describes the Curv's DuoDivide system as two short parallel rollers with spiral blades. This is the main-brush assembly, not a brush cover.

Roborock Qrevo Curv replacement filters

Two washable filters.

View filters on Amazon ↗

Fit: Roborock's U.S. accessories catalog lists a washable-filter family for Qrevo Curv Series, and the Amazon title explicitly names Qrevo Curv. These filters fit the robot dustbin; they are separate from the filter in the dock cleaning tray and from disposable dock bags.

Replace when: Roborock recommends cleaning the washable filter every 2 weeks and replacing it every 6–12 months, or sooner if damaged or still clogged after cleaning.

Before buying: Confirm Qrevo Curv and the two-filter option in the selected Amazon variation. Rinse with clean water only and let the filter dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

U.S. robot and dock
The U.S. manual identifies robot V10VIV and Empty Wash Fill Dock EWFD26LRR. Match both labels; this guide's dock-bag advice is for the standard Empty Wash Fill Dock configuration.
DuoDivide main brush and FlexiArm side brush
Qrevo Curv uses two short parallel DuoDivide rollers and an arc-shaped FlexiArm side brush. Check for these exact assemblies; a conventional Qrevo roller or brush cover is a different part.
Washable filter vs. dock bag
The washable filter sits in the robot dustbin. The disposable bag sits inside the dock. They are separate consumables with different fit checks.
Mop cloths and model variants
The standard Curv uses round spinning cloths. Roborock says its Curv cloth listing does not fit CurvX; Qrevo Curv 2 Flow uses a roller-mop system, so this cloth guide is not for that model.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock Qrevo Curv maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Roborock Qrevo Curv cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
DuoDivide main brushesEvery 2 weeks6–12 months
FlexiArm side brushMonthly3–6 months
Washable robot filterEvery 2 weeks6–12 months
Mop clothsAs required1–3 months
Dock dust bagDisposableAs required or when full

Switch off the robot before servicing brushes or mop parts. Rinse the washable filter with clean water only and let it air-dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling.

Before you order

How do I identify the U.S. Roborock Qrevo Curv?

The U.S. manual lists robot model V10VIV and Empty Wash Fill Dock model EWFD26LRR. Check both labels before choosing parts.

Which main brush does the Qrevo Curv use?

It uses the DuoDivide assembly with two short parallel rollers and spiral blades. Choose a listing that names Qrevo Curv and shows the complete DuoDivide brush.

Do Qrevo Curv mop pads fit CurvX?

Roborock explicitly says its Qrevo Curv and Edge round mop cloths are not compatible with CurvX. This guide's third-party cloth listing names standard Qrevo Curv; verify your exact model before ordering.

Are these all genuine Roborock parts?

The linked DuoDivide brush, side brushes and washable filters are Roborock-branded. The mop cloths and dock bags are third-party items; DustMigo has not physically tested their fit or durability.

How often should I replace Qrevo Curv filters and brushes?

Roborock recommends replacing the main brushes and washable filter every 6–12 months and the side brush every 3–6 months. Clean the main brushes and filter every 2 weeks, and clean the side brush monthly.
